newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Karwell to use Walt Disney trade mark.
newsitem.headline: Karwell to use Walt Disney trade mark.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Karwell Indonesia said on Tuesday a subsidiary had obtained a licence to produce and sell garments in Indonesia using Walt Disney's trade mark "Pooh".

"Our subsidiary PT Karwell Kreasi Indonesia has recently signed a deal with Walt Disney Singapore that enabled us to produce and sell garments using the Pooh trade mark in Indonesia," one Karwell official said.
The medium-sized textile firm expected to launch T-shirts using the popular Walt Disney character later this month, the official said.
The official declined to give further details.
